sum: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc., a multi-platform media company, owns and operates radio stations in the United States. It operates in two segments: Audio and Digital. The company offers local and national advertisers integrated marketing solutions across audio, digital, and event platforms. The company owns 49 radio properties located in large and medium-sized markets. Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. was founded in 1961 and is based in Naples, Florida.
ceo: Ms. Barbara Caroline Beasley (Chairman, CEO & Interim Principal Financial Officer)
